# Montana jail-roster data request

Subject: Request for daily current-inmate roster delivery

Hello,

Montana Blotter is a free, open-source Montana public-records service. We are building a statewide directory of current county detention rosters using official agency data.

We could not locate a machine-readable current-inmate roster for [COUNTY] County. Would your office provide one of the following?

1. The official URL for an existing current-inmate roster, PDF, CSV, or API;
2. A daily current-roster PDF or CSV sent to records@montanablotter.com; or
3. The name of the detention facility or neighboring county that houses [COUNTY] County prisoners.

For an emailed roster, the useful fields are inmate name, booking date/time, booking or jacket number, age if published, charges or hold reason, and current/released status. We can accept PDF, CSV, XLSX, DOCX, or plain-text email.

We publish the official source and update time with the data. We do not alter the underlying agency record, and we remove people from the current-roster view when a later roster no longer lists them.

Please also tell us whether the roster has a regular publication schedule and whom we should contact if delivery stops.

Thank you,
Montana Blotter
https://montanablotter.com
records@montanablotter.com
